verdict.rationale: OpenClaw publishes a releases page (docs.openclaw.ai/releases.md) with release notes describing new features such as installing plugins without restarting and teams of specialist agents, so some changelog exists. Nothing in the pack documents version numbering, upgrade or migration guidance, or a repair or rollback path for a broken update. missing for 10: explicit versioned release scheme, migration/breaking-change notes, documented update procedure, repair or rollback path after a failed update, independent corroboration of safe upgrades.
